inShort: A and B play a dink-only game. A ball that lands on or behind your own kitchen line is a point for the other player.
rules: A and B stand straight across at the kitchen line. Dinks only, no hard hits.
A ball that lands on or behind your own kitchen line is a point for the other player: you should have taken it out of the air.
Win points by pulling the other player wide, then pushing the next dink deep past their line.
Find your range: stand right on the line or a step back, wherever you can still cover it.
First to 11, then start the next game.
tooEasy: Play it cross-court: there is more line to protect.
tooHard: Play without points and just practise taking every ball out of the air.
goodLooksLike: Hardly any ball lands behind your line, and you take balls early without leaving the kitchen line.
